entries.title: NCSC warns of messaging app targeting
entries.summary: The NCSC has issued actions for individuals at risk of targeted attacks against messaging apps.

entries.title: Vulnerability affecting F5 BIG-IP APM
entries.summary: The NCSC is encouraging UK organisations to mitigate an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability affecting F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager.

entries.title: Vulnerabilities affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway
entries.summary: UK organisations encouraged to take immediate action to mitigate two recently disclosed vulnerabilities affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway.

entries.title: NCSC CEO: Seize 'disruptive' vibe coding opportunity to make software more secure
entries.summary: Dr Richard Horne delivered a keynote about cyber risks and opportunities at the RSAC Conference in San Francisco

entries.title: International security chiefs to convene in Glasgow for flagship CYBERUK conference
entries.summary: CYBERUK will be delivered by the NCSC and sponsors across four distinct tracks of activity: Resilience, Technology, Threat, and Ecosystem.
